digest.component_or_area: llm workflow and plan review modules
propositions: Nine modules are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap, blocking further feature work on story 343b which requires adding a parameter to finalize_verdict across five call sites

gate_dispatch.py has only 1 line of headroom but contains three of the five finalize_verdict call sites that story 343b needs to modify, making the required change physically unlandable without a split

The plan-review recovery cluster (STEP_* constants, GateContractError, recovery functions, metrics collection) forms a cohesive call-graph seam within gate_dispatch.py that can be extracted to a new module with zero test edits

The context-assembly cluster in orchestrator.py is a self-contained, run-scoped unit (assemble_context, assemble_cache, related helpers) that can be extracted to reduce orchestrator.py from 796 to under 700 LOC

Extracting these two seams will provide 271 lines of headroom in gate_dispatch.py and 154 lines in orchestrator.py, unblocking 343b's gap-5 wiring and establishing precedent for handling the remaining three modules at exactly 800 LOC
